note: Demo pages served at /demo. The three bank pages name SBI but have no form, script or typing. All other organisations are fictional. `bubble` and `link_check` are checked by server/tests/test_demo_pages.py against the real rules on a tunnel address. Sample {base} = the server's public address.

pages.label: Bank login
pages.shows: An ordinary-looking login. The closer look is what catches the fake bank.
